info.title: Kauro API
info.description: Generated by tools/openapi.mjs; do not edit. Operations come from the vendored registry commands.json (provenance-verified); request schemas, the response views derived from the registry contracts, the envelopes and the Problem document are the application-owned schemas the api's closed validator compiles and its send guard validates every reply with. x-kauro-planned documents designed operations no route serves yet (keyed "METHOD path"), generated from the same contracts.

post.description:
Precondition: No existing membership is assumed. The identity must be verified and creation abuse limits must admit the request.

Effect: Create one draft agency and owner membership atomically; do not activate contracts or billing automatically.

Failure: A repeated identical key returns the same agency; a conflicting key rejects without a second tenant.

ImportStageView.title: ImportStageView
ImportStageView.description: An import stage (B17: CMD040's answer and CMD041's): its dependency order, target object and operation, state, exact package and deadline, and the summary of its latest validated receipt; the stage's source identities and the receipt's source-to-target mapping stay in the stage and the receipt, never in the view.
ImportStageView.$comment: Projection of registry contract ImportStage. Every registry member is selected.

version.description: The stage's version (CMD041's expectedVersion): every receipt revision and the continuation advance it.

receiptRevision.description: The latest validated receipt revision of the stage: a correction is a new revision, never an overwrite.

receiptResult.description: What the latest receipt concluded: every identity matched, a fully accounted partition with explicit failures, or unresolved identities that block the child edges needing them.

identityMappingHash.description: The KAURO_STAGE_IDENTITY_MAPPING_V1 digest of the latest validated receipt: what CMD041's validatedReceiptHash names.

matchedRows.description: Source identities mapped unambiguously to a target identity.

failedRows.description: Source identities the receipt reports as explicitly failed.

unresolvedRows.description: Source identities missing, named twice or mapped to a target identity another source also claims.

continuedAt.description: When the approver recorded the continuation (the database's instant); absent before.

permittedActions.description: The commands the caller may issue on this stage, derived server-side from the caller's role and the stage's state; informative, never authority (B06 D-PERM-1).

IncidentView.title: IncidentView
IncidentView.description: CMD056: the incident as recorded. A false positive is CLOSED, says so in its severity and opens no responsibility; an actual incident is DETECTED with its open responsibilities and its next checkpoint.

severity.description: The recorded severity, or FALSE_POSITIVE for a monitoring false positive.

affectedScopeRefs.description: The safe scope identifiers the incident affects.

communicationState.description: Customer communication is reviewed by the owner for S1 and S2; nothing is sent automatically.

openResponsibilities.description: The responsibilities still to be evidenced separately.

startedAt.description: The instant the database recorded the incident.

InspectionColumnView.title: InspectionColumnView
InspectionColumnView.description: One positional column of a detected table (03 "Source identity": positional ids independent of labels; duplicate and empty headers are surfaced).

label.description: Untrusted header text for display (absent when empty or undecodable); the UI escapes it.

InspectionFileView.title: InspectionFileView
InspectionFileView.description: An admitted file with its detected tables (registry FileManifest; "Only provider-observed bytes and generations may be admitted").
InspectionFileView.$comment: Projection of registry contract FileManifest. Withheld: storageRef (A private registry object reference (registry: never a public bucket URI); the tenant has no use for it.); providerGeneration (A provider generation locates stored customer bytes; the file is identified by fileId and bound by sha256 and bytes.)

sha256.description: Hash recomputed over the complete object bytes.

bytes.description: Observed byte length within the applicable envelope.

scanState.description: Coverage is separate from malware absence.

parserProfileHash.description: Pinned encoding, dialect, workbook and parser configuration.

admitted.description: Derived server decision; a browser cannot set this value.

origin.description: Admitted from this revision's uploads, or a previously admitted file of the project the selection may reuse.

InspectionTableView.title: InspectionTableView
InspectionTableView.description: A detected worksheet or CSV table with its structural facts (04 "XLSX parser requirements": hidden worksheets stay in the inventory, formula text is inert, merged cells as observed).

ordinal.description: Workbook order; 0 for a CSV table.

name.description: Untrusted worksheet name for display; the UI escapes it.

visibility.description: Worksheet visibility; a hidden table is never silently included (CMD016).

rowEstimate.description: A structural estimate from the preflight; never the counted population.

formulaCache.description: The cached-value situation of the formulas.

issues.description: Stable issue codes (encoding, delimiter ambiguity, duplicate headers, blank lines, ...).

structureHash.description: KAURO_SOURCE_TABLE_V1 digest of the detected facts: a selection binds it.

InspectionView.title: InspectionView
InspectionView.description: GET /revisions/{revisionId}/inspection (10: files, detected worksheets, parser choices and structured problems), with the inventory hash a selection manifest is made against (D-SEL-3).

inventoryHash.description: KAURO_SOURCE_INVENTORY_V1 digest of the uploads, files and tables below.

uploads.description: Every upload of the revision, terminal ones included (a rejection is listed with its class, never silently dropped).

files.description: Admitted files of this revision, then reusable admitted files of the project.

selection.description: The bound selection's table choices (the manifest document is its own resource).

evaluation.description: The latest evaluation of the bound selection.

InviteMemberCompleted.title: CMD003 COMPLETED
InviteMemberCompleted.description: Synchronous success: the validated DTO and the version of the aggregate the command edited or created (10 "Responses and safe errors"); replayed is true when an idempotent replay returned the journaled result (10 "Idempotency contract").

InviteMemberView.title: InviteMemberView
InviteMemberView.description: CMD003 InviteMember result: the pending membership and its invitation. The single-use token is a member of the FIRST execution's reply only; the journal holds no token and a replay answers without it (docs/design/B16-team-commands.md D-TEAM-1).

invitationId.description: The invitation (a forwarded token names this id, never another agency).

agencyId.description: The agency the invitation is explicitly scoped to.

expiresAt.description: When the invitation stops being acceptable, on the database clock.

JobView.title: JobView
JobView.description: A processing job's safe progress (10 "Long work returns 202 with operationId, current state, status URL and allowed polling guidance"; design B08 §12): its state, attempt ordinal, deadlines, cancellation version and, once READY, its package id — never a provider identity, an object name, the fence or a customer value.
JobView.$comment: Projection of registry contract Job. Withheld: fence (The publication fence is control-plane authority: only the fenced accepted attempt publishes, and the customer's view of progress never needs it.); lease (Active ownership names a worker instance and its expiry: an operating fact of the control plane, not of the customer.); providerJobId (The actual Batch or equivalent execution identity is a provider identifier; the view carries activeProviderState instead (10: no provider identity in a response).); inputBindingHash (Digest of the source, plan, target, core and policy bundle: the job's admission fact, kept in its audit trail.); packageId (Served as publishedPackageId, present exactly once the verified publication committed (Q8-8: only the package id).); deadline (The registry's single boundary is served as two named instants: deliveryDeadlineAt (the promise) and executionDeadlineAt (the absolute execution boundary set at launch).)

version.description: The job's optimistic version (the fence between a cancellation and a concurrent transition or publication, CMD037 expectedVersion).

deliveryDeadlineAt.description: The instant the delivery must have happened by: the capture's completion plus forty-eight hours (D8-RET-1).

executionDeadlineAt.description: The absolute execution boundary, set at launch (absent while QUEUED).

cancelVersion.description: How many cancellations the job recorded (CMD037 moves it once).

activeProviderState.description: What the provider is doing for the live attempt, as far as the platform's own record shows it; absent while QUEUED and once the job ended.

publishedPackageId.description: The accepted output, present only after the verified publication (Q8-8).

permittedActions.description: The execution commands the caller may issue on this job, derived server-side from the caller's role and the job's state; informative, never authority (B06 D-PERM-1).

MembershipView.description: Team information appropriate to the caller: no authentication tokens, recovery settings or security evidence (10 "Agency and team routes").
MembershipView.$comment: Projection of registry contract Membership. Every registry member is selected.

MoneyComponents.title: MoneyComponents
MoneyComponents.description: The three components of a capture or a refund in MoneyMinorUnits (15 "A partial refund names the affected service component and allocates tax consistently"; the excess is an overpayment, never service).

excessCents.description: Amount above the order's obligation (R2-140); refundable, never service revenue or commission basis.

PaymentOrderDetailView.title: PaymentOrderDetailView
PaymentOrderDetailView.description: GET /api/v1/payment-orders/{orderId}: the reconciled order with its captures, its authorization and its fiscal documents.

captures.description: Every capture fact of the order.

PaymentOrderView.title: PaymentOrderView
PaymentOrderView.description: The reconciled payment order (10 "GET returns reconciled state. A browser return endpoint only navigates to that state"; 15 "Payment pending", "Payment confirmed", "Payment failed", "We are checking this payment").
PaymentOrderView.$comment: Projection of registry contract PaymentOrder. Withheld: merchantRef (The receiving merchant is server configuration (15 "Merchant identity and environment are fixed by server configuration"), not an agency fact.); idempotencyHash (The intent binding is the server's idempotency record (10 "Read endpoints return safe projections").)

paymentStatus.description: Derived from reconciled facts only (15 "Payment state transitions"); CHECKING while an effect is uncertain.

nextActions.description: Safe next actions; while uncertain the platform discourages paying again (15).

checkout.description: Present while the buyer can approve at the provider.

PayoutIntentView.title: PayoutIntentView
PayoutIntentView.description: CMD052: the payout the owner authorized — the statement's own amount under one reference. No destination and no destination digest (D10-PAY-1).

state.description: Payout intent lifecycle: AUTHORIZED until the provider's evidence says otherwise.

amountCents.description: The statement's payable amount, in minor units.

feeBearer.description: Kauro bears the provider's payout fee: the seller receives the whole amount.

reference.description: The one reference the provider's evidence must name.

destinationVersion.description: The version of the stored destination the intent is bound to; never the destination.

statementState.description: The statement's state after the authorization.

PayoutReconciliationView.title: PayoutReconciliationView
PayoutReconciliationView.description: CMD053: the payout after the authenticated evidence was applied — the intent's and the statement's states and how many lines were paid or held.

intentState.description: The intent's state after the evidence.

statementState.description: The statement's state after the evidence.

payoutEvidenceHash.description: The digest of the settled evidence; present once a payout settled.

settledAt.description: The instant the provider says the payout settled.

reviewOn.description: The date a failed or returned payout is reviewed.

PeriodCloseView.title: PeriodCloseView
PeriodCloseView.description: CMD051: the closed period and the close's totals. Per-seller rows are not a member: a seller reads only their own statement.

ledgerCutoffHash.description: The digest of the exact ledger the close computed over.

payableTotalCents.description: The total payable across the issued statements, in minor units.

heldTotalCents.description: The total held across the issued statements, in minor units.

guardReviewCount.description: Statements a guard held for review: a count, never the finding.

PlanImpactMap.title: PlanImpactMap
PlanImpactMap.description: Dependent evidence the revision invalidated (Plan machine "Invalidate only dependent evidence with impact map").

validationReceiptHash.description: The predecessor's receipt, when it was VALIDATED or APPROVED.

approvalId.description: The predecessor's approval, when it was APPROVED.

PlanView.title: PlanView
PlanView.description: A plan revision summary: its lifecycle, its bindings and its lineage. The plan body is not part of a summary.
PlanView.$comment: Projection of registry contract Plan. Withheld: mappings (Plan body (customer field names and decisions, possibly L3/L4 per FIELD_CONTRACTS "Common rules"); served by the plan routes of the audit package, never by a command reply.); identities (Plan body; as mappings.); transforms (Plan body; as mappings.); relationships (Plan body; as mappings.)

bodyHash.description: Digest of immutable plan semantics; lifecycle state/version envelope and final approval are excluded by the named preimage.

validationReceiptHash.description: The current validation receipt of this revision, once validated.

approvalId.description: The approval of this revision, once approved.

supersededByPlanId.description: The successor revision once superseded (design D-PLAN-1).

permittedActions.description: The served commands the caller may issue on this resource, derived server-side from the caller's role, the resource's state and, for an approval, its control (07 "The handoff to UI includes every state, safe field, permitted action"); informative, never authority (re-check finding N16).

PreviewTableReply.title: PreviewTable READ
PreviewTableReply.description: A read: the safe projection the caller may see, with the version of every resource that edits compare (10 "Read endpoints return safe projections", "Resource reads return a version or ETag where edits are supported").

ProjectDashboardItem.title: ProjectDashboardItem
ProjectDashboardItem.description: One project of the agency's dashboard (11 "Project dashboard", UI11): client, mode, current revision, phase, required agency action, deadline and last activity, each from a durable fact of the project (the client's display name, the current revision, the latest plan, quote, entitlement and job); nothing inferred.

clientLabel.description: The client's display name, an untrusted label.

phase.description: The project's phase, from its durable facts.

requiredAction.description: The one action the agency must take next; NONE when the next step is Kauro's or the project is terminal.

deadline.description: The issued quote's expiry while it awaits payment, the live job's delivery deadline while processing; null otherwise.

lastActivityAt.description: When the fact that decides the phase last changed.

ProjectDashboardPage.title: ProjectDashboardPage
ProjectDashboardPage.description: A page of the agency's project dashboard under one filter, newest project first ((createdAt, projectId) descending).

nextCursor.description: The cursor of the next page, when there may be one (opaque, bound to the caller, the agency, the filter and this order).

ProjectDashboardRevision.title: ProjectDashboardRevision
ProjectDashboardRevision.description: The current revision of a dashboard project: its identity and lifecycle state.

ProjectRevisionPointerView.title: ProjectRevisionPointerView
ProjectRevisionPointerView.description: The project after CMD012 moved its current revision.

ProjectView.title: ProjectView
ProjectView.description: A project with its current revision summary and the readiness blockers computed from durable facts at read time (CMD011 effect "visible readiness blockers"; 10 "A UI readiness flag is informative, not authority"). The registry has no Project contract (design D-AGG-1, open question Q4).

targetInstanceRef.description: Declared target instance for a CRM mode (design D-CMD-4).

readinessBlockers.description: Readiness blockers in a fixed order.

permittedActions.description: The served commands the caller may issue on this resource, derived server-side from the caller's role, the resource's state and, for an approval, its control (07 "The handoff to UI includes every state, safe field, permitted action"); informative, never authority (re-check finding N16).

ProspectView.title: ProspectView
ProspectView.description: A prospect of the commercial pipeline (owner manual 18): limited to lawful commercial context; the restricted contact record it refers to is never answered.
ProspectView.$comment: Projection of registry contract Prospect. Withheld: businessContactRef (Reference to the restricted contact record: contact details never leave it and are never named in a report (D10-API-1).)

sourceEvidenceHash.description: Where and why the prospect was legitimately collected.

jurisdiction.description: Applicable outreach territory, not guessed from language alone.

suppressed.description: Global no-send control that overrides automation.

ProtectedSessionView.title: ProtectedSessionView
ProtectedSessionView.description: The resumable provider session, delivered only to its requester in the protected response of CMD013, its replay and the session read, while the upload is UPLOADING and unexpired (10 "Upload and target routes"; 09 "Resumable session security": the reference is a bearer credential, never logged, cached, emailed or shown to another reader). delivery PROTECTED_RESPONSE carries uploadUrl, method, chunkMultipleBytes and applicationExpiresAt; UNAVAILABLE carries unavailableReason only.

uploadUrl.description: The resumable session URL (a bearer credential; Cache-Control no-store on every reply).

method.description: The method the client resumes with.

chunkMultipleBytes.description: The chunk multiple the client respects when resuming from the provider-confirmed offset.

applicationExpiresAt.description: The application acceptance deadline; the provider session may outlive it, acceptance does not (R2-051).

unavailableReason.description: Why the session is not delivered.

QuoteEligibilityView.title: QuoteEligibilityView
QuoteEligibilityView.description: How the quote's discount was decided (design §3.2, §3.3; 16 "the highest eligible rate, never a sum"): the repeat lookback and the founding offer.

qualifyingProjectCount.description: Qualifying completed purchases of this agency inside the lookback window.

repeatDiscountBps.description: The discount the repeat rule allowed, in basis points.

foundingOffer.description: What the founding offer did: reserved a slot, the agency was not eligible, or no slot remained.

appliedDiscountBps.description: The one discount applied to the quote: the highest eligible rate.

lookbackStartsAt.description: The start of the repeat lookback window.

QuoteReplacementView.title: QuoteReplacementView
QuoteReplacementView.description: A superseded quote and the authorization its replacement revoked, when a new quote replaces one already paid (design §3.4).

replacedQuoteId.description: The quote the new one replaces.

revokedAuthorizationId.description: The commercial authorization revoked by the replacement; absent when the re-binding was refused.

approvalRequired.description: The new plan must be approved again before it can be paid.

outcome.description: REBOUND: the paid purchase stands on the replacement. WITHDRAWN: the payment service refused the re-binding and the replacement was withdrawn.

reason.description: The first blocker that refused the re-binding, as the payment service names it.

QuoteView.title: QuoteView
QuoteView.description: The quote the agency reviews and pays (10 "GET /quotes/{quoteId} returns price components, tax status, discount provenance, expiry and data availability. It also returns checkoutReady and structured blockers").
QuoteView.$comment: Projection of registry contract Quote. Every registry member is selected.

discountCents.description: Applied maximum eligible promotion, not stacked.

termsHash.description: Accepted scope, refund, retention and contract terms.

version.description: Quote version (the terms are immutable; the state moves).

discount.description: The one applied discount and its provenance (16: the highest eligible rate, never a sum).

taxTreatment.description: The reviewed treatment the quote was issued under (an unreviewed treatment never issues a quote).

checkoutReady.description: Derived at read time from the durable facts; informative, never authority (10 "A UI readiness flag is informative").

checkoutBlockers.description: Why checkout is not ready, in check order (07 "Checkout readiness is a derived predicate").

permittedActions.description: The payment commands the caller may issue here, derived from role and state; informative, never authority.

ReceivePaymentWebhookCompleted.description: Synchronous success: the validated DTO and the version of the aggregate the command edited or created (10 "Responses and safe errors"); replayed is true when an idempotent replay returned the journaled result (10 "Idempotency contract").

captures.description: Every capture fact of the order.

effects.description: What the observation did, per fact it was about (the member is not named subject: that name is reserved for the provider subject of the authenticator).

openCases.description: Reconciliation cases still open for the order.

RecordIncidentCompleted.description: Synchronous success: the validated DTO and the version of the aggregate the command edited or created (10 "Responses and safe errors"); replayed is true when an idempotent replay returned the journaled result (10 "Idempotency contract").

RecoveryAuthorizationView.title: RecoveryAuthorizationView
RecoveryAuthorizationView.description: CMD057: the recovery authorized for a prepared restore candidate. The restore is run and released by the control plane after its integrity, tenant, deletion and financial checks.

authorizedAt.description: The instant the database recorded the authorization.

version.description: The restore candidate version after the authorization.

RefundEffectsView.title: RefundEffectsView
RefundEffectsView.description: The prepared commission and fiscal effects an approval commits to (CMD032 precondition "commission/fiscal effects are prepared"; 10 "The owner sees the exact amount, reason, provider effect and commission/tax consequences").

creditNoteRequired.description: A service or tax component is refunded, so a credit note follows the completion.

serviceBasisAfterCents.description: The capture's service basis after this refund: commission recomputes cumulatively from it (R2-081).

revokesAuthorization.description: The refund leaves no service basis and the authorization is revoked at completion.

remaining.description: What stays refundable after this refund.

effectsHash.description: KAURO_REFUND_EFFECTS_V1 digest of the prepared effects.

RefundReviewView.title: RefundReviewView
RefundReviewView.description: The corporate owner's review packet of one refund (GET /api/v1/operations/refunds/{refundId}): exact amounts, reason, provider effect and commission/tax consequences — commerce facts only, no customer workspace data (08 "Private Owner ... has no automatic customer-record bypass").

refundable.description: What the capture still allows, given every committed refund.

termsHash.description: The accepted terms of the purchase.

applicablePolicies.description: Standing policies that cover the proposed refund as it stands (a reference, never invented).

proposedEffects.description: The effects approving the proposal would commit to.

RefundView.title: RefundView
RefundView.description: A refund as the agency may see it: the request, its review state and the reconciled effect (15 "Refund policy and calculation"); never the approver's identity or the provider's refund id.
RefundView.$comment: Projection of registry contract Refund. Withheld: providerRefundId (Provider identities stay in the restricted reconciliation domain.); authorizationHash (Absent until approval; the approval appears as its own member once recorded (the registry requires the member of an approved refund).); evidenceHash (Finance evidence reference of the reconciliation store.)

amountsBasis.description: serviceCents and taxCents are the reviewer-visible proposal until approval, then the immutable approved intent.

origin.description: Who asked: the agency, the reconciler for an excess capture, or Kauro's remedy.

deliveryPhase.description: The processing/delivery state recorded with the request (15).

excessCents.description: The excess component (an overpayment return carries only excess).

reviewRequired.description: True while the request awaits the corporate owner's review; a request is never itself permission for a provider transfer.

failureCode.description: Why a refund failed (a server token).

RetentionView.description: A retention record governing a revision's data (09 "Retention schedule"; HASHING "Retention formulas"; registry RetentionRecord: the effective deadline is a minimum of named anchors and retries do not extend it).
RetentionView.$comment: Projection of registry contract RetentionRecord. Withheld: scope (The enclosing revision names the agency, project and revision the record governs.)

softDeadline.description: Policy interval from the applicable ready event.

hardDeadline.description: Absolute maximum from the owning immutable event.

effectiveDeadline.description: Minimum active deadline after all relevant caps.

providerResiduals.description: Observed classes that outlive active access with reasons.

RevisePlanCompleted.title: CMD023 COMPLETED
RevisePlanCompleted.description: Synchronous success: the validated DTO and the version of the aggregate the command edited or created (10 "Responses and safe errors"); replayed is true when an idempotent replay returned the journaled result (10 "Idempotency contract").

RevisePlanView.title: RevisePlanView
RevisePlanView.description: CMD023 RevisePlan result: the new revision, the superseded predecessor and the impact map.

RevisionImpactView.title: RevisionImpactView
RevisionImpactView.description: Authority that does not carry onto the new bytes (CMD012 failure: do not carry old validation, approval or paid execution authority onto changed bytes; identified, never transferred).

planIds.description: Plans that name the predecessor's manifest hash.

commercialAuthorizationIds.description: Live commercial authorizations bound to the predecessor (none before the payments package, B09).

RevisionQuotaView.title: RevisionQuotaView
RevisionQuotaView.description: The revision's intake envelope as committed (R2-052: the database decides on the committed ledger; the view informs).

reservedBytes.description: Bytes held: reservations in flight and admitted observed bytes.

fileCount.description: Uploads in flight and admitted files.

agencyActiveSessions.description: The agency's upload sessions in flight.

agencySessionLimit.description: Policy capacity.agencyUploads, as operations set it for the agency.

RevokeMembershipCompleted.description: Synchronous success: the validated DTO and the version of the aggregate the command edited or created (10 "Responses and safe errors"); replayed is true when an idempotent replay returned the journaled result (10 "Idempotency contract").

SalesAccountView.title: SalesAccountView
SalesAccountView.description: CMD048: the agency's account assignment after the owner assigned a seller to service it.

sellerId.description: The seller who services the account.

newWorkCompensation.description: Whether the new seller earns anything for new work of the account.

assistanceAgreementId.description: The assistance agreement, present when new work is compensated as assistance.

SealRevisionCompleted.title: CMD017 COMPLETED
SealRevisionCompleted.description: Synchronous success: the validated DTO and the version of the aggregate the command edited or created (10 "Responses and safe errors"); replayed is true when an idempotent replay returned the journaled result (10 "Idempotency contract").

SealRevisionView.title: SealRevisionView
SealRevisionView.description: CMD017 SealRevision result: the sealed revision, its manifest and projection digests and the UNPAID retention record anchored on the seal.

manifestHash.description: KAURO_SOURCE_REVISION_V1 digest of the sealed manifest: exactly HASHING's preimage (accepted files, table selection, parser profile, projection; B07-F12).

projectionHash.description: Digest of the sealed projection and pricing interpretation.

sealedSubjectHash.description: KAURO_SOURCE_SEALED_SUBJECT_V1 digest of the sealed subject: this revision, its lineage, the manifest and the frozen counts (D-HASH-4). Named apart from the forbidden identity member subjectHash (B06 FORBIDDEN_RESPONSE_FIELDS).

retention.description: The UNPAID record: hard deadline fourteen days from the seal.

SelectInputTablesCompleted.title: CMD016 COMPLETED
SelectInputTablesCompleted.description: Synchronous success: the validated DTO and the version of the aggregate the command edited or created (10 "Responses and safe errors"); replayed is true when an idempotent replay returned the journaled result (10 "Idempotency contract").

SelectInputTablesView.title: SelectInputTablesView
SelectInputTablesView.description: CMD016 SelectInputTables result: the revision INSPECTING with its new selection, uncounted until SELECTION_EVALUATION counts it.

SelectionManifestIntakeView.title: SelectionManifestIntakeView
SelectionManifestIntakeView.description: The selection manifest intake (D-SEL-2): stored once per revision and body hash; the same body again answers the stored manifest with created false.

selectionManifestId.description: The manifest identity CMD016 names as selectionManifestRef.

bodyHash.description: KAURO_SOURCE_SELECTION_V1 digest of the document: the selectionHash CMD017 confirms.

created.description: False when the same document was already stored for this revision.

SelectionManifestView.title: SelectionManifestView
SelectionManifestView.description: A stored selection manifest (D-SEL-1): the closed document — dispositions, parser choices, projection and associations; ids, digests, tokens and positions only.

SellerTerminationView.title: SellerTerminationView
SellerTerminationView.description: CMD050: the terminated seller and what the termination did to the seller's claims, prospects, assignments and entitlements.

state.description: Seller lifecycle state after the command.

tailEndsAt.description: The instant the tail of residual entitlements ends.

tailEntries.description: Entitlements that continue through the tail.

SellerView.title: SellerView
SellerView.description: CMD049: the seller after activation. Whether a payout destination is verified, never the destination.

state.description: Seller lifecycle state: only ACTIVE may act.

classification.description: The reviewed classification of the relationship.

payoutDestinationVerified.description: A payout destination is verified for this seller; the destination itself is never answered.

SourceRevisionView.title: SourceRevisionView
SourceRevisionView.description: A dataset revision: its lifecycle, lineage, bound selection, frozen populations, seal and retention (10 "Client and project routes"; 09 "Notifications and customer action": dataAvailableUntil on every source screen once a record governs it).
SourceRevisionView.$comment: Projection of registry contract DatasetRevision. Withheld: scope (The agencyId and projectId members carry the tenant binding.); files (The inspection read serves the file set with its tables; a revision summary does not repeat it.); manifestHash (Required by the registry of a sealed contract; a mutable revision has none, so the view serves it inside `seal`, present exactly once the revision is sealed.); projectionHash (As manifestHash: served inside `seal`.)

supersedesRevisionId.description: Explicit predecessor, never an in-place overwrite.

supersededByRevisionId.description: The successor once SUPERSEDED or replaced (D-REV-1).

selection.description: The bound selection and the inventory it was made against (D-SEL-3).

evaluationHash.description: The evaluation that froze the populations (READY_TO_SEAL onwards).

populations.description: The four populations frozen by the evaluation of the bound selection (RowCounts members; 03 "Count the correct population"): physical rows, logical records after projection, billable units before deduplication, association edges.

seal.description: The sealed subject: manifest and projection digests (KAURO_SOURCE_REVISION_V1), included files and bytes.

retention.description: The records governing the revision's data.

dataAvailableUntil.description: The earliest effective deadline of the governing records.

terminalReason.description: Why the revision closed (CANCELLED, REJECTED, EXPIRED).

blockers.description: Why the revision cannot move forward now, recomputed at read time from durable facts (10: a readiness flag is informative, not authority).

permittedActions.description: The source-lifecycle commands the caller may issue on this resource, derived server-side from the caller's role, the resource's state and, for an upload, whether the caller requested it; informative, never authority (B06 D-PERM-1).

StatementBalanceItemView.title: StatementBalanceItemView
StatementBalanceItemView.description: An unrecovered balance a statement carries and what it waits on (design §6).

kind.description: What the balance waits on: an offset, a repayment review, a write-off or a dispute.

lineId.description: The line the balance came from.

StatementItemView.title: StatementItemView
StatementItemView.description: One commission line of a statement: the purchase's basis, the rate and share, the cumulative entitlement, what was paid before, the adjustment and what is held (design §6).

agencyId.description: The agency whose purchase the line commissions.

sequence.description: The agency's first qualifying purchase or a repeat.

netServiceBasisCents.description: The net service basis in minor units: excess capture and tax are never basis.

rateBps.description: The commission rate in basis points.

shareBps.description: The seller's share of the entitlement in basis points.

cumulativeEntitlementCents.description: The cumulative entitlement of the line, in minor units.

adjustmentCents.description: The adjustment of this statement, in minor units.

adjustmentDirection.description: Whether the adjustment raises or lowers the payable amount; absent when there is none.

heldCents.description: What is held from this line.

holdReason.description: Why an amount is held (a server token); present with a hold.

holdReviewOn.description: The date a hold is reviewed; present with a hold.

SubmitDecisionArtifactReply.title: SubmitDecisionArtifact STORED
SubmitDecisionArtifactReply.description: A document intake (B07 D-SEL-2, B08 D8-PLAN-1): the stored document's identity; created false (200) when the same body was already stored for this revision or audit (content-idempotent, no journal entry, no aggregate version), created true (201) when this request stored it.

SubmitSelectionManifestReply.title: SubmitSelectionManifest STORED
SubmitSelectionManifestReply.description: A document intake (B07 D-SEL-2, B08 D8-PLAN-1): the stored document's identity; created false (200) when the same body was already stored for this revision or audit (content-idempotent, no journal entry, no aggregate version), created true (201) when this request stored it.

SubmitStageReceiptCompleted.title: CMD040 COMPLETED
SubmitStageReceiptCompleted.description: Synchronous success: the validated DTO and the version of the aggregate the command edited or created (10 "Responses and safe errors"); replayed is true when an idempotent replay returned the journaled result (10 "Idempotency contract").

SupersededPlanSummary.title: SupersededPlanSummary
SupersededPlanSummary.description: The predecessor revision after RevisePlan: SUPERSEDED at its new version.

SupportCasePage.title: SupportCasePage
SupportCasePage.description: A page of one project's support cases in (createdAt, caseId) order, oldest first.

nextCursor.description: The cursor of the next page, when there may be one (opaque, bound to the caller, the project and this list).

SupportCaseView.title: SupportCaseView
SupportCaseView.description: A support case as its agency sees it (owner manual 18: support metadata must not become an unrestricted raw-data channel): the classified case with the covered-hours follow-up. It cites uploads by id only and never the requester's user id (B11 W4).
SupportCaseView.$comment: Projection of registry contract SupportCase. Every registry member is selected.

createdByMembershipId.description: The membership that opened the case (an agency-internal identity the caller already sees in team views).

version.description: The case version: 1 when opened, one more for every edit.

TablePreviewView.title: TablePreviewView
TablePreviewView.description: A bounded authorized sample of an admitted table (10 "A preview endpoint returns a bounded authorized sample with safe display escaping and no shared caching"; D-SAPI-7): at most 20 rows of at most 50 columns, each cell at most 200 characters of decoded text the UI escapes; never cached, never logged.

columns.description: The previewed columns in position order.

rows.description: Decoded cell text per row, null for an empty cell; formula text is inert text.

truncated.description: Whether rows, columns or cells were cut to the bounds.

TargetContractView.title: TargetContractView
TargetContractView.description: A target contract version (B17: CMD018's and CMD019's answer): its CRM mode, instance and importer bindings, the digest of its immutable body, the observation and confirmation instants and its version; the metadata objects stay in the contract, never in the view.
TargetContractView.$comment: Projection of registry contract TargetContract. Withheld: objects (The complete observed metadata is the contract's body: the view names it by bodyHash and objectCount; it is data the importer consumes, never a customer value of this reply.)

projectId.description: The project the contract was observed for.

mode.description: Public mode; legacy adapter mapping is explicit.

bodyHash.description: Digest of the immutable target-body preimage defined in HASHING_AND_ACCOUNTING_RULES; confirmation and attestation envelope are verified separately.

confirmedAt.description: Agency confirmation of this exact version.

capabilityVersion.description: Version of the supported capability matrix.

version.description: The contract's version: 1 as a DRAFT, 2 once confirmed (CMD019's expectedVersion).

state.description: DRAFT until the agency confirms this exact body, CONFIRMED afterwards, SUPERSEDED once a later contract replaced it.

objectCount.description: How many target objects the stored body describes.

permittedActions.description: The commands the caller may issue on this contract, derived server-side from the caller's role and the contract's state; informative, never authority (B06 D-PERM-1).

TaxDocumentView.title: TaxDocumentView
TaxDocumentView.description: A fiscal document of the order (15 "TaxDocument state machine": a provider PDF is not acceptance; the legal number appears only after authenticated issuance).
TaxDocumentView.$comment: Projection of registry contract TaxDocument. Withheld: fiscalProfileId (The reviewed fiscal facts are the operator's private record.); providerDocumentId (Provider identities stay in the restricted reconciliation domain.); evidenceHash (Finance evidence reference of the reconciliation store.)

taxTreatment.description: The treatment of the draft or of the issued document.

blockedReason.description: Why a draft cannot be validated: the concrete fiscal action (R2-082, R2-128).

TeamMemberView.title: TeamMemberView
TeamMemberView.description: A teammate as the caller may see it (10 "GET /agencies/{agencyId}/members returns only team information appropriate to the caller. It does not expose authentication provider tokens, recovery settings or another member's private security evidence"; re-check finding N16). A caller who manages the team sees every membership with its lifecycle times; any other member sees the ACTIVE team's roles.
TeamMemberView.$comment: Projection of registry contract Membership. Withheld: agencyId (The path names the agency every listed membership belongs to.); userId (Another person's identity reference is not team information appropriate to every caller; the caller's own membership is marked self.); assurancePolicy (The membership's authentication-strength configuration is security configuration, not team information (10: no recovery settings or security evidence).)

self.description: Whether this is the caller's own membership.

createdAt.description: When the membership was created; shown to a caller who manages the team.

TeamPage.title: TeamPage
TeamPage.description: A page of the agency's team as the caller may see it, in (createdAt, membershipId) order.

nextCursor.description: The cursor of the next page, when there may be one (opaque, bound to the caller, the agency and this list).

TerminateSellerCompleted.title: CMD050 COMPLETED
TerminateSellerCompleted.description: Synchronous success: the validated DTO and the version of the aggregate the command edited or created (10 "Responses and safe errors"); replayed is true when an idempotent replay returned the journaled result (10 "Idempotency contract").

TransferOwnershipCompleted.title: CMD007 COMPLETED
TransferOwnershipCompleted.description: Synchronous success: the validated DTO and the version of the aggregate the command edited or created (10 "Responses and safe errors"); replayed is true when an idempotent replay returned the journaled result (10 "Idempotency contract").

TransferOwnershipView.title: TransferOwnershipView
TransferOwnershipView.description: CMD007 TransferOwnership result: the agency at its new version, the successor who became OWNER and the former owner who stays ADMIN.

previousOwner.description: The former owner's membership, now ADMIN.

UploadInspectionView.title: UploadInspectionView
UploadInspectionView.description: One inspection receipt's separate results (09 "Completion and inspection": STRUCTURE_VALID, SCAN_COMPLETE_NO_DETECTION and SEMANTIC_NOT_YET_PROFILED are separate fields).

structureStatus.description: Structural result of the bounded preflight.

scanState.description: Coverage is separate from malware absence.

semanticStatus.description: Inspection never claims a semantic profile.

detectedFormat.description: Detected format, compared with the declared one.

claimConsistent.description: Whether the browser's completion claim agreed with the server's observation (a claim is never authority).

scanCoverage.description: Expected parts and bytes against actual scan coverage (09 Scanner coverage; S054).

problems.description: Stable problem codes; never an archive entry name or a cell value.

rejectionClass.description: The precise rejection class (09 Completion and inspection; D-INSP-3).

UploadPage.title: UploadPage
UploadPage.description: A page of the revision's uploads in (createdAt, uploadId) order (10 "Pagination, search and exports").

nextCursor.description: The cursor of the next page, when there may be one (opaque, bound to the caller, the revision and this list).

UploadView.title: UploadView
UploadView.description: Safe progress of one upload (10 "GET returns safe progress without exposing the session URI to unrelated readers"; UI14 "Separate upload progress, provider observation, scanner coverage, parser state and accepted bytes").
UploadView.$comment: Projection of registry contract UploadSession. Withheld: providerSessionSecretRef (Private bearer reference (registry: never included in generic DTO/logs); the session is delivered only by the protected response to its requester (D-SESSION-2).); observedGeneration (A provider generation locates stored customer bytes; progress carries the observed length and time instead, and the sealed manifest binds generations by digest (09 Storage zones and object registry).)

displayName.description: Untrusted display filename (09: display metadata only, never part of a storage path, an event or a log); the UI escapes it.

declaredFormat.description: Declared format (CMD013 declaredFormat, narrowed to the supported formats, D-SAPI-4).

observation.description: What the provider actually holds, once the server observed it (S053: observation, never the browser's claim).

inspection.description: The inspection outcome as separate results (09: no single generic safe flag).

terminalReason.description: Why application acceptance ended (CANCELLED, EXPIRED or REJECTED).

createdAt.description: Initiation; the application deadline is exactly twenty-four hours later (09 Upload reservation).

permittedActions.description: The source-lifecycle commands the caller may issue on this resource, derived server-side from the caller's role, the resource's state and, for an upload, whether the caller requested it; informative, never authority (B06 D-PERM-1).

WebhookAck.title: WebhookAck
WebhookAck.description: CMD030's answer to the provider: whether the authenticated event was recorded and how it was disposed; no business detail.

received.description: The authenticated event is durably recorded.

inboxState.description: The consumer outcome of the recorded event.

duplicate.description: The same event (identity and body) was recorded before; nothing was applied again.

conflict.description: A delivery of this event identity carried another body; it is recorded and never applied (B06 D-ING-1).

WithdrawApprovalCompleted.title: CMD026 COMPLETED
WithdrawApprovalCompleted.description: Synchronous success: the validated DTO and the version of the aggregate the command edited or created (10 "Responses and safe errors"); replayed is true when an idempotent replay returned the journaled result (10 "Idempotency contract").

WithdrawApprovalView.title: WithdrawApprovalView
WithdrawApprovalView.description: CMD026 WithdrawApproval result: the withdrawn approval, the WITHDRAWN plan and the completed external actions, identified separately; no rollback or refund member.

completedExternalActions.description: Completed external or customer actions, never promised reversible.

createInquiryRequest.title: createInquiry request
createInquiryRequest.description: A fit inquiry from a visitor without an account. The buyer type never changes price or admission (A3 3.7).

getCurrentSessionResponse200.title: SessionView
getCurrentSessionResponse200.description: The signed-in person and the session: verification facts as flags, the deadlines of the session, the freshness of its latest step-up and its CSRF token (B11 design D-AUTH-4).

openSessionResponse201.title: SessionView
openSessionResponse201.description: The signed-in person and the session: verification facts as flags, the deadlines of the session, the freshness of its latest step-up and its CSRF token (B11 design D-AUTH-4).

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Required on every command (10 "Idempotency contract"); a retry after a lost response reuses it.

AgencySelector.name: X-Kauro-Agency
AgencySelector.description: The active agency context of a route whose path carries no agencyId (design D-SCOPE-1): a selector, never authority.

CorrelationId.name: X-Correlation-Id
CorrelationId.description: Opaque correlation id (10 "Request envelope"): adopted when it is an id of this shape; any other value is ignored — never refused, never echoed — and the server mints one, as when it is absent (review decision E-CORR-1). Every reply carries the id the request was handled under.

InquiryOrigin.name: Origin
InquiryOrigin.description: The exact origin of the public site or of the application as a browser writes it (B11 D-PUB-2, D-AUTH-5): compared as a whole string before the body is read; an absent header or any other origin is NOT_AUTHORIZED ORIGIN_REJECTED. The api never answers with a cross-origin header.

PageLimit.name: limit
PageLimit.description: Page size (10 "Pagination, search and exports"; the R2 policy's api.pageDefault 25 and api.pageMaximum 100).

PageCursor.name: cursor
PageCursor.description: The nextCursor of the previous page: opaque, integrity-protected and bound to the caller, the agency, the list, its filter and its order (10 "Pagination, search and exports"; R2-060). Any other cursor is CURSOR_INVALID.

CsrfToken.name: X-Kauro-CSRF
CsrfToken.description: The session's CSRF token (SessionView.csrfToken): required on an unsafe request the session cookie authenticates (B11 D-AUTH-5); refused as CSRF_TOKEN_INVALID otherwise.

CorrelationId.description: The correlation id of the request, on every reply.

CacheControl.description: Every reply is private (08 "Browser, API and cache isolation": private responses use an explicit no-shared-cache policy): it is never stored by a shared or a private cache.

SetSessionCookie.description: The session cookie (__Host-kauro_session): set by sign-in, cleared (Max-Age=0) by logout.

ClearSiteData.description: The logout clears the site's cache, cookies and storage where the browser allows it (08 "Browser, API and cache isolation").

serviceAuth.description: A verified service identity: issuer, audience, expected identity and environment (COMMAND_CATALOGUE "Service commands require a verified service identity and audience, with scope derived from the stored operation"; package B09 D-AUTHZ-B3).

sessionCookie.name: __Host-kauro_session
sessionCookie.description: The browser session (B11 design D-AUTH-1, D-AUTH-5): Secure; HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax. An unsafe request it authenticates needs the exact application Origin, a same-origin Sec-Fetch-Site and the session's X-Kauro-CSRF token; a cookie beside an Authorization header is AMBIGUOUS_CREDENTIALS.
